why: Bezrealitky's czechRegions API serves no Prague districts, and its id for
Prague itself (R435514) is not the one their search recognizes. These ids
are the ones the portal's own frontend ships hardcoded in its JS bundle;
they are not OSM relations and cannot be harvested from any API. The
harvest script still live-verifies every one of them before writing.
The praha region override triggers the harvest NOTICE on every run by
design: their API keeps serving R435514 while their search only knows
R435541 - that NOTICE is the standing record of the disagreement, not
a problem to fix. Re-derivation recipe: the harvest script's docstring.
